tool_schemas.name: slack_list_channels
tool_schemas.description: Lists channels in the workspace scoped by the given installation and returns a single page of cached channel records filtered by types and include_archived; pagination uses cursor and returns at most limit items along with a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if installation_id/cursor/limit/types are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the installation does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the installation is not authorized to read channels in the workspace; may raise RATE_LIMITED when Slack or this service enforces request limits.

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to scope the workspace.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of channels.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return.

tool_schemas.name: slack_post_message
tool_schemas.description: Posts a new message to the specified cached channel using the OAuth tokens from the installation, persists the Slack message id/timestamp in the cache, and returns the created message record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed, text is empty, or blocks/attachments payloads are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the installation or channel_id does not exist in the cache, and FORBIDDEN if the installation lacks permission to post to the channel; may raise RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion and CONFLICT if the channel is not in a postable state (e.g., archived).

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to use for posting via the stored OAuth tokens.

channel_id.description: Internal cached channel id to post into.

blocks.description: Slack Block Kit blocks payload to include with the message.

attachments.description: Slack legacy attachments payload to include with the message.

tool_schemas.name: slack_reply_to_thread
tool_schemas.description: Posts a reply to the thread whose parent is the given cached message id, persists the Slack reply id/timestamp and thread linkage, and returns the created reply message record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed, text is empty, or blocks/attachments payloads are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the installation or parent_message_id is unknown, and CONFLICT if the parent message is not a threadable root in our cache; raises FORBIDDEN if the installation cannot post in that channel/thread and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are hit.

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to use for posting via the stored OAuth tokens.

parent_message_id.description: Internal cached message id of the thread parent to reply to.

text.description: Reply text to post in the thread.

blocks.description: Slack Block Kit blocks payload to include with the reply.

attachments.description: Slack legacy attachments payload to include with the reply.

tool_schemas.name: slack_add_reaction
tool_schemas.description: Adds the given emoji reaction (by name, without colons) to the specified cached message via the installation’s OAuth tokens, updates the cached reactions, and returns the updated message/reaction state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed or emoji_name is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the installation or message_id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the installation cannot react in the message’s channel; raises CONFLICT if the reaction already exists or the message cannot be reacted to, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to use for reacting via the stored OAuth tokens.

message_id.description: Internal cached message id to add the reaction to.

emoji_name.description: Emoji name to add (without colons), e.g. thumbs_up.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_channel_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of cached messages for the given cached channel, filtered by oldest/latest and inclusive, ordered as Slack history is returned; pagination uses cursor and returns up to limit messages with a next cursor when more are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids/cursor/limit or oldest/latest values are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the installation or channel_id is unknown, and FORBIDDEN if the installation is not authorized to read that channel’s history; may raise RATE_LIMITED under request throttling.

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to scope the workspace.

channel_id.description: Internal cached channel id to read message history from.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of messages.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

oldest.description: Only include messages with Slack ts greater than or equal to this value.

latest.description: Only include messages with Slack ts less than or equal to this value.

inclusive.description: Whether to include messages exactly at oldest/latest boundaries.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_thread_replies
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of cached replies for the thread rooted at parent_message_id, filtered by oldest/latest and inclusive; pagination uses cursor and returns up to limit replies with a next cursor when more are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids/cursor/limit or oldest/latest values are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the installation or parent_message_id is unknown, and CONFLICT if the referenced message is not a thread parent in our cache; raises FORBIDDEN if the installation cannot read the thread and RATE_LIMITED when throttled.

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to scope the workspace.

parent_message_id.description: Internal cached message id of the thread parent to fetch replies for.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of replies.

limit.description: Maximum number of replies to return.

oldest.description: Only include replies with Slack ts greater than or equal to this value.

latest.description: Only include replies with Slack ts less than or equal to this value.

inclusive.description: Whether to include replies exactly at oldest/latest boundaries.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_users
tool_schemas.description: Lists users in the workspace for the given installation and returns a single page of cached user records (optionally including deactivated users); pagination uses cursor and returns up to limit users with a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if installation_id/cursor/limit are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the installation does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the installation is not authorized to read users for the workspace; may raise RATE_LIMITED when request limits apply.

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to scope the workspace.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of users.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_user_profile
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns the detailed cached profile for the specified user in the installation’s workspace. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if installation_id or user_id are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the installation or user does not exist in the cache, and FORBIDDEN if the installation is not authorized to view the user’s profile; may raise RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to scope the workspace.

user_id.description: Internal cached user id to fetch detailed profile information for.

tool_schemas.name: slack_sync_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Synchronizes cached workspace state (users and channels, and optionally message history) for the given installation by calling Slack APIs using the stored OAuth tokens, upserting records, updating last_synced_at fields, and returning a summary of created/updated counts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the installation does not exist, CONFIGURATION_ERROR if no active installation is available, and FORBIDDEN if required Slack scopes are missing or the installation is not active.

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to sync.

sync_users.description: Whether to sync users from Slack into slack_users.

sync_channels.description: Whether to sync channels from Slack into slack_channels.

sync_messages.description: Whether to sync message history into slack_messages.

channel_ids.description: If provided, restrict message sync to these cached channel ids.

oldest.description: When syncing messages, only fetch messages at or after this Slack timestamp.

latest.description: When syncing messages, only fetch messages at or before this Slack timestamp.

limit_per_channel.description: When syncing messages, maximum messages to fetch per channel per run.

tool_schemas.name: slack_update_installation_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions an installation lifecycle status (active/disabled/revoked) and returns the updated installation record. Refuses invalid transitions (e.g., revoked -> active), and refuses any update that would violate workspace scoping rules. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the installation does not exist, CONFLICT if the requested transition is not allowed, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to manage installations.

installation_id.description: Slack installation record id to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the installation.

last_api_error.description: Optional last API error message to store for diagnostics.

tool_schemas.name: slack_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the caller identity and authorization context for this MCP server, including the resolved active installation (if any), granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption known to the service. Raises CONFIGURATION_ERROR if no active installation is available when one is required to answer the request.

include_rate_limits.description: Whether to include current Slack API rate-limit/usage snapshot if available.
